scope: Continuity decisions in multilingual conversational-agent workflows
does_not_establish: A bounded inspiration artifact, not a research-gap, novelty, prevalence, or lifecycle certificate.

sources.title: HINDSIGHT: Structured Agent Memory that Retains, Recalls, and Reflects

inspection_spans.observation: HINDSIGHT separates facts, beliefs, and observations in persistent memory with parallel retrieval and temporal organization.
Evaluation is English-only; extraction errors can propagate and opinion evolution lacks formal user validation.

sources.supports: An inspectable persistent-memory architecture and an explicit English-only evidence boundary.
sources.does_not_establish: Multilingual state continuity or language-switch behavior.

sources.title: Mem2ActBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory in LLM Agents

inspection_spans.observation: The benchmark requires agents to recover evolving long-term constraints for underspecified tool invocations; human review finds 91.3% strongly memory-dependent.
Performance falls as grounded parameter values become more complex.
The asset targets memory-grounded tool parameterization and does not itself evaluate multilingual control-plane routing.

sources.supports: A memory-dependent action contract and a concrete parameter-grounding failure boundary.
sources.does_not_establish: Whether a language switch loses memory or merely routes intact state through a different language configuration.

sources.title: PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents

inspection_spans.observation: The benchmark embeds multilingual inputs, intermediate reasoning, tools, and outputs in 67 long-horizon tasks across five domains.
Strict arithmetic or schema errors can invalidate entire workflows, so aggregate Pass@1 can misrepresent reliability.
Results vary across task domains and languages; the benchmark plans to expand rather than establishing a universal workflow distribution.

sources.supports: A multilingual long-horizon workflow benchmark and evidence that errors compound across execution steps.
sources.does_not_establish: Isolation of persistent-memory loss from language control, harness, judge, or task-design effects.

sources.title: Design effective language understanding — Microsoft Copilot Studio

inspection_spans.observation: System.User.Language is the central control point for knowledge search and response language and can be set, overridden, or automatically detected.
Critical content may require custom translation; multilingual deployments require synchronization, testing, fallback, and monitoring.

sources.supports: A production language control plane that can reroute search, response, and orchestration independently of remembered task facts.
sources.does_not_establish: Observed memory loss, failure prevalence, or the correctness of automatic detection.

sources.title: Multilingual agents — Dialogflow CX

inspection_spans.observation: Most agent data is shared, while training phrases, fulfillment responses, and entity entries must be supplied per language; generated translations require review.
Automatic switching cannot distinguish some locale variants and text integrations use only the default language.

sources.supports: A production distinction between shared agent state and language-specific/control-plane data with documented switching limits.
sources.does_not_establish: That a user-visible continuity failure is caused by memory rather than configuration or locale routing.

tension_clusters.label: A user-visible language switch can change retrieval, response, locale data, and flow routing even when persistent task state remains intact
tension_clusters.actor: Conversational-agent owners and users resuming multi-turn work across languages
tension_clusters.incumbent_practice: Persist general agent state while selecting or auto-detecting a language that controls retrieval, responses, locale data, and flows.
tension_clusters.material_consequence: A continuity failure may trigger the wrong memory repair, localization repair, fallback, or workflow decision.
alternative_explanations: Persistent task memory was lost or conflicted
Memory remained intact but language control selected different retrieval/response/locale assets
The benchmark or judge conflates long-horizon execution error with memory loss
tension_clusters.does_not_establish: Failure prevalence, a memory mechanism, or that either vendor implementation is representative.

controller_boundary: Review-only source reduction; no gap, novelty, prevalence, proposal, or lifecycle transition is established.
